tools.description: Azure CLI embedded Python interpreter with Azure SDK modules
tools.usage: python -c \"import azure.cli.core; print('Azure CLI Python')\" # Test Azure modules\npython -m pip list | grep azure # List Azure packages

tools.description: Azure CLI Windows Python interpreter without console window
tools.usage: pythonw azure_script.py # Run Azure script silently\npythonw -c \"import azure.cli; azure.cli.main()\" # Launch Azure CLI GUI mode
